facts.fact: The cathedral stands in Guadalajara historic centre.
The municipal description identifies Gothic, Renaissance and Neoclassical elements rather than one uniform style.
facts.excerpt: mezcla de gótico, renacentista y neoclásico

facts.fact: Its interior contains altars and artworks; the building remains an active religious place.
Religious festivities and community events take place during the year; the visitor should adapt to worship.
